title.narrative: Improvement of water supply systems in rural areas, Albania

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to promote sustainable social and economic development in Albaniand rural areas.The specific objective of the Action is to improve the living conditions of the inhabitants and encourage economic development through small and medium size interventions into rural water supply systems.Results: Water supply systems in selected rural areas constructed, ensuring the population has access to dinking water of quality according to hygienic norms.
